facts.text: Patient X presented lethargic, not eating or drinking, with a known history of heart murmur.
Patient X was lethargic and difficult to transport; the owner noted that when the door opened, Patient X would try to bolt, and the handler had to carry him physically.
Patient X has a self-taught habit of covering himself with a blanket at home, which the owner described as cute and something they wish their dog would do.
The plan was to place an IV catheter in Patient X and run saline through it. No sedation was planned; the procedure was described as a 'quick line' lasting approximately five to ten minutes.
